channel.title: Replaced by AI Layoff Tracker
channel.description: Recent sourced AI layoff tracker entries.

item.title: Microsoft AI layoffs, July 6, 2026
item.description: Microsoft: 4,800 layoffs. AI reorg or spending linked. BBC reported that Microsoft announced 4,800 job cuts, roughly 2.1% of its workforce, with Xbox bearing a large share of the layoffs amid a significant restructure and Microsoft continuing to prioritize artificial intelligence spending.

item.title: Amperity AI layoffs, June 25, 2026
item.description: Amperity: – layoffs. Explicit AI cited. GeekWire reported that Amperity conducted layoffs as the customer data startup transforms its operations around AI, with the company saying the shift changes where it invests and the shape of the team it needs.

item.title: Elastic AI layoffs, June 24, 2026
item.description: Elastic: 281 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Elastic announced an organizational change including an approximately 7% workforce reduction, about 281 workers, while CEO Ash Kulkarni said advances in AI and automation are letting the company operate with leaner teams.

item.title: Snyk AI layoffs, June 24, 2026
item.description: Snyk: 90 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Globes reported that cybersecurity company Snyk is laying off about 90 employees in Israel and worldwide, while Cybernews reported that the company is reorganizing to prioritize its AI Security Platform development.

item.title: General Motors AI layoffs, June 22, 2026
item.description: General Motors: 1,300 layoffs. Automation / efficiency cited. Ars Technica reported that General Motors installed about 50 collaborative robot arms at Factory Zero while 1,300 workers remained out of work following a temporary layoff tied to idled EV production.

item.title: Oracle AI layoffs, June 22, 2026
item.description: Oracle: 21,000 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Oracle's FY2026 Form 10-K confirmed a drop from approximately 162,000 full-time employees at the end of FY2025 to approximately 141,000 at the end of FY2026, a 21,000-role reduction that BBC and CNBC reported in the context of Oracle's AI spending and restructuring.

item.title: Optimove AI layoffs, June 17, 2026
item.description: Optimove: – layoffs. Explicit AI cited. InterGame reported that Optimove CEO Pini Yakuel said the marketing services provider would cut 10% of staff in a push toward AI and train remaining employees to shape the next version of the company.

item.title: Robinhood AI layoffs, June 16, 2026
item.description: Robinhood: 290 layoffs. Speculative / unclear. Robinhood announced a reduction in force affecting approximately 10% of full-time employees, with reporting putting the cut at about 290 roles, as part of a push to stay lean, flatten layers, and accelerate product velocity.

item.title: Rackspace Technology AI layoffs, June 10, 2026
item.description: Rackspace Technology: 750 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Rackspace Technology approved a workforce realignment expected to terminate approximately 15% of its global workforce, roughly 750 roles based on its latest reported 5,000-person employee base, as it deemphasizes legacy public-cloud service delivery and redeploys resources toward governed enterprise AI.

item.title: Shopee AI layoffs, June 10, 2026
item.description: Shopee: – layoffs. AI-adjacent restructuring. The Straits Times, citing Bloomberg, reported that Sea's Shopee cut hundreds of developer jobs globally during a pivot toward AI, affecting about 8% of Shopee's developer workforce.

item.title: Paytm AI layoffs, June 9, 2026
item.description: Paytm: 400 layoffs. AI-adjacent restructuring. Moneycontrol, carrying Bloomberg, reported that Paytm would lay off about 400 employees after its appraisal cycle while hiring about 4,000 people as part of a pivot toward merchant expansion and AI-driven product offerings.

item.title: Salesforce AI layoffs, June 8, 2026
item.description: Salesforce: 86 layoffs. AI reorg or spending linked. Salesforce began another round of layoffs, with a California WARN notice listing 86 cuts and reporting saying affected teams included Agentforce, MuleSoft, and Marketing Cloud as the company reshapes around AI offerings.

item.title: GitLab AI layoffs, June 1, 2026
item.description: GitLab: 350 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. GitLab approved a restructuring plan expected to impact about 14% of its global workforce, with reporting putting the cut at roughly 350 employees, while CEO Bill Staples framed the move around GitLab's Act 2 strategy for the agentic era and AI-powered ways of working.

item.title: Interview Kickstart AI layoffs, May 29, 2026
item.description: Interview Kickstart: 50 layoffs. Automation / efficiency cited. Inc42 reported that Interview Kickstart undertook a restructuring amid rising AI automation, with sources estimating 80 to 100 roles affected and the cofounder saying fewer than 50 employees were impacted.

item.title: SentinelOne AI layoffs, May 28, 2026
item.description: SentinelOne: – layoffs. AI-adjacent restructuring. SentinelOne announced a restructuring plan to reduce current full-time employees by about 8% while streamlining its organization and concentrating investments in growth areas including AI, Data, Cloud, and Endpoint.

item.title: Wix AI layoffs, May 28, 2026
item.description: Wix: 1,000 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. CNBC reported Wix is laying off about 20% of its workforce after CEO Avishai Abrahami cited the fast evolution of AI capabilities and pressure from shekel-dollar exchange rates.

item.title: ClickUp AI layoffs, May 21, 2026
item.description: ClickUp: – layoffs. Explicit AI cited. TechCrunch reported ClickUp laid off 22% of its workforce after CEO Zeb Evans announced a 100x organization push built around internal AI agents and AI-enabled productivity gains.

item.title: Groupon AI layoffs, May 21, 2026
item.description: Groupon: 400 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Groupon announced an initial restructuring phase expected to reduce up to 400 global positions, including employees and contractors, as part of its strategy to rebuild the company as an AI-native company.

item.title: Intuit AI layoffs, May 20, 2026
item.description: Intuit: 3,000 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Yahoo Finance / Reuters reported Intuit is laying off about 17% of its workforce, or about 3,000 employees worldwide, to streamline operations and sharpen focus on key bets including AI efforts.

item.title: Standard Chartered AI layoffs, May 19, 2026
item.description: Standard Chartered: 7,000 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Reuters reported Standard Chartered plans to cut more than 7,000 jobs over the next four years as it boosts adoption of artificial intelligence while targeting growth.
